title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR 4 — remember prior: Adam's sin = act + following corruption
pass_a_gloss: GAR's fourth move: recall the earlier reading. Take Adam's sin not as the bare act alone, but with the corruption it produced—then it is rightly imputed to the posterity, for both act and following corruption are the sin.
pass_b_english: GAR. 4. But so they argue: they ought to have been mindful of those things which they said before. If Adam's sin is taken not for the act itself precisely taken, but together with the corruption which it begot, Adam's sin is rightly said to be imputed to the posterity. For so it will be sin, both Adam's act itself and the following corruption.
source_text: GAR. 4. At sic argumentantur, eos memores esse oportebat eorum quae prius dixerunt. Si peccatum Adami accipiatur non pro actione ipsa praecise sumpta, sed simul cum corruptione quam peperit, recte dici Adami peccatum posteris imputari. Nam ita peccatum erit, & ipsa Adami actio & corruptio consequens.

lemmas.gloss: to be imputed to the posterity
